//: Deployment sample: copy it as context.json next to the package on the host. Never put real secrets here.
The merged configuration, later layers win:
4. in-package config/routemodule.config.json: ContextName and AutoStart only
Every {{key}} without a {{key:default}} in the XML must get a value from one of these layers:
the built package lists them in manifest.json under RequiredConfigKeys, and the module stops at init when one is missing.
s3.accessKey and s3.secretKey are such keys; the secret key goes through the environment.
AWS S3: s3.serviceUrl empty, s3.region your region, s3.forcePathStyle false.
